name: Shiraki Makito
source: A young man that seems to have hidden intentions behind his actions. Since he has no steady job, he goes through his days aimlessly. According to the man himself, he gains unearned income so he's not concerned. Even though he enters others' homes without permission and even raped Tagane, usually he's calm and is fairly gentle. Like Tagane, Makito's also careless and irresponsible in some respects.
